title: Coffee & Good Conversations
description: Meet new people, share stories, and enjoy a relaxed morning over coffee. No agenda, no pressure — just good conversations and good company.

title: Create & Connect
description: Spend an afternoon painting, experimenting with colors, and discovering your creative side. All skill levels are welcome.

title: Sunday Picnic Club
description: Bring your favorite snacks and meet new faces for a relaxed picnic filled with laughter, games, and lovely conversations.

title: Pasta, Friends & Stories
description: Cook a delicious meal together, discover new flavors, and enjoy a shared dinner. Come for the food, stay for the people.
